cohort: The study cohort consisted of patients undergoing 12 types of surgical procedures across 29 International Nosocomial Infection Control Consortium (INICC) member hospitals in 22 cities in Bahrain, Egypt, Kuwait, Lebanon, and Saudi Arabia.
finding: Most surgical site infection (SSI) rates in Middle Eastern INICC hospitals are comparable to those of CDC/NHSN, though some specific procedures (Appendix surgery, coronary artery bypass, open reduction of fracture, and exploratory abdominal surgery) showed significantly higher rates, and cesarean sections showed a significantly lower rate.
mod_finding: The cesarean section SSI rate in INICC hospitals of the Middle East was significantly lower (1.04%) compared to CDC/NHSN rates (1.5%).
